connector.name: Zephyr Scale MCP
connector.registryDescription: Zephyr Scale on self-hosted Jira Server/DC: test cases, cycles, executions, plans and attachments
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package zephyr-scale-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the vilaabo account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: JIRA_BASE_URL
env.description: Jira base URL without a trailing slash, e.g. https://jira.example.com

env.name: JIRA_PAT
env.description: Jira Data Center Personal Access Token (used when JIRA_AUTH=pat, the default)

env.name: ZEPHYR_DEFAULT_PROJECT_KEY
env.description: Project key used when a tool is called without projectKey

env.name: ZEPHYR_ALLOW_INTERNAL_API
env.description: true registers 11 UNOFFICIAL tools backed by the internal /rest/tests/1.0 API the vendor does not support: editing a test cycle in place (rename/move, add/remove/reorder its cases), editing or DELETING individual executions, linking a cycle to a test plan, the folder tree, folder deletion, exact status names and custom field definitions

env.name: JIRA_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED
env.description: false allows self-signed certificates (disables TLS verification)

env.name: JIRA_TIMEOUT_MS
env.description: Timeout of a single HTTP request in milliseconds (default 30000)

env.name: JIRA_MAX_RETRIES
env.description: Retries for GET requests and for 429/503 responses, honoring Retry-After (default 2)

env.name: ZEPHYR_LOG_LEVEL
env.description: Log verbosity: debug | info | warn | error (default info; all logs go to stderr)
